::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 1st [1871]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd)

I think you should poke up [Strahan](people/person_1278.qmd), though I fancy he is very tiresome about MSS. [^1]  I hope you have a copy – [Goosedom](organizations/other_104.qmd) is very poor this time, all the best being busy or going travelling  [Frog](people/person_822.qmd) is gone to Ammergau[^2]

your affectionate
Mother Goose

---

[^1]: Endorsed 'Envelope shows 1871'.
[^2]: Probably this refers to some attempt by Coleridge to publish fiction in [*Good Words*](organizations/other_73.qmd), the magazine published by Alexander Strahan.
[^3]: The decennial performance of the Passion Play in the Bavarian village of Oberammergau had become a popular tourist attraction.  The 1870 performance was interrupted by the outbreak of the Franco-Prussian War, and was resumed in June 1871 (*Pall Mall Gazette* 9 June 1871).
